nodes.label: Admin authentication mechanism
nodes.rationale: No email allow-list: any authenticated Supabase Auth user is treated as admin, so access is governed entirely by who has a Supabase account, meaning public sign-ups must stay disabled.

nodes.label: Path alias @/* → src/*
nodes.rationale: Shortens imports and avoids relative-path churn across the src/ tree.

nodes.label: Server Components by default
nodes.rationale: Client components are opt-in via "use client" only where interactivity is needed, minimizing client JS.

nodes.label: Secrets in .env.local
nodes.rationale: Secrets are kept out of version control (gitignored) while every variable is documented in .env.example for onboarding.

nodes.label: Domain logic lives in services/
nodes.rationale: Keeps components presentational by isolating data access/business logic in services/.

nodes.label: Placeholder catalog fallback
nodes.rationale: Until migrations run, queries silently fall back to the local placeholder catalog in src/constants/, so the site renders identically either way.

nodes.label: Catalog revalidate = 60s (ISR)
nodes.rationale: Catalog pages revalidate every 60s in production so seeded Supabase data appears within a minute; in dev it appears on the next request.
